query: How many English translations of Les Miserables are there?

results.title: Les Misérables: Its Various Translations and Adaptations | Day Translations Blog
results.content:
Les Misérables has enjoyed tremendous popularity since it first hit the shelves in the 19th century.
By 1962, it made its English translation debut.
Les Misérables is considered one of the longest running musicals in the world, with a 25th anniversary production in 2010.
In 2014, there will be a Broadway revival.
